name: Deep-Dig Grayson

greeting: Another day. Another hundred tons. What do you need?
Grayson. I run this dig. What management THINKS they run is another matter.
You're the ones asking questions. Make it quick. Shift's wasting.
Deep-Dig Grayson. Twenty years in the dark. Still got all my fingers. Most of 'em.
Heard about you. Heroes or troublemakers? Hard to tell the difference these days.
If you're from corporate, save your breath. Safety isn't negotiable.
The rock don't care who you are. Treat it with respect.
What brings you down to our level? Above ground too sunny for you?
work_complaint: Management wants production up, costs down. Simple math. Deadly math.
Three collapses this month. 'Natural instability,' they say. I say: shortcuts.
dialog.professional_pride: See that seam? Running pure obsidian. Deepest cut in three generations. My grandfather started it. I'll finish it.
dialog.technique: The trick is listening. Rock talks. Groans. Creaks. You learn the language, or you learn to fly. Briefly.
dialog.break_chat: Break's sacred. Even heroes don't interrupt a man's sandwich. Especially not Brutalia's sandwiches. They're... dense.
dialog.labor_concerns: Union's all we've got. Management's cutting corners. I've buried too many friends. Not. One. More.
dialog.retirement: Two more years. Gonna buy a boat. Something that FLOATS. Above ground. Where there's SUN.
rumor: Trenchcoat in the executive tunnels? Corporate spy. Count on it.
Tunnel 7's sealed for a reason. Something down there. Something that ain't rock.
Coolcat's fighting for us in the meetings. Good soul. Don't know if it'll be enough.
Brown, my shift supervisor? He wants my job. Let him have it. Sooner the better.
Heard from Frost - they found something in the ice. Old. Older than old. Keep your pick sharp.
dialog.quest_hook: Safety violations everywhere. Management won't listen. Workers won't work. Someone's gotta bridge the gap. Someone neutral. Someone like you.
dialog.quest_active: Still no word from the board? Figures. They count coins. We count casualties.
dialog.quest_complete: You actually did it. Agreement signed. New safety protocols. Here - my grandfather's pick head. It's seen worse than this. Make it see better.
farewell: Watch your head. And your back.
Don't trust the easy path. It's usually a collapse waiting to happen.
Go with the rock, not against it.
ambient_barks: Who ordered the new drill heads?
dialog.time_dawn: Morning shift. Best light for spotting cracks.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Halfway to freedom. Or the next level down.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Long shadows in the tunnels. Watch your step.
dialog.time_night: Night crew's on. The deep hours. That's when things get... interesting.
dialog.family_mention: My brother works Frost. Weather balloonist. Says it's cold. I say he doesn't know what work is.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The negotiator. Brought us peace. Brought me hope. Rare commodities down here.

party_reactions.kade: This guy's carrying the weight of the whole operation. I respect that.
party_reactions.nix7: Experience level: Expert. Stress indicators: Elevated. Solution: Unclear.
party_reactions.twist: He's like a grumpy mountain! I like mountains!
party_reactions.korr: A leader who listens. Rare in any world.
party_reactions.renna: The magical residue here is... old. Ancient. He's right to be cautious.
party_reactions.suresh: His burden reminds me of temple guardians. Same quiet strength.
party_reactions.sova: Twenty years digging? I'd go crazy. He's already halfway there.
party_reactions.grit: Reminds me of my old sergeant. Seen too much, still showing up.
party_reactions.senna: He knows where all the bodies are buried. Literally, probably.
party_reactions.callum: Someone should tell him about workers' rights in the capital...

relationship_dialog.stranger: New face. Stay clear of the active cuts.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: You're persistent. That's good. In this job, persistence keeps you breathing.
relationship_dialog.friend: I trust you. That's not something I say easy. You've got honest eyes.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Listen... Tunnel 7. The sealed one. You want to know why? I'll show you. But not today. Soon.

mini_quest.title: Safety Violations
mini_quest.description: Help the tunnel workers negotiate better safety conditions with corporate management

stages.hook: Workers won't dig unsafe. Management won't pay for safety. Stalemate. Someone needs to talk sense. Both sides. You willing?
stages.active: Talk to the corporate spy in the trenchcoat. And Brutalia - she knows management's weaknesses. Find leverage. Find common ground.
stages.complete: Agreement reached. Signed and sealed. First real win we've had in years. My grandfather's pick - it's yours. Use it for good work.

cross_npc_connections: tunneler_brown: Wants my job. Good at the work, bad with people. He'll learn. Or he won't.
coolcat_industrial: Union rep. Sharp mind. Fighting for us in the boardroom.
trenchcoat_gray: Corporate eyes. But you? You might reach him. Worth a try.
aeronaut_white_frost: My brother. Send him my regards. Tell him the dark isn't so bad.
